product.name: Klaro Automated Testing Suite
product.tagline: Comprehensive automated testing with 500+ commits for complete system reliability
product.overview: Full-spectrum automated testing for the Klaro monorepo — unit tests, integration tests, E2E with Playwright screenshots, CI/CD with 80% coverage gate. Every source file gets unit tests. Every test case = 1 commit for maximum history.

architecture.dbMocking: In-memory SQLite via better-sqlite3 with Drizzle
architecture.e2eScreenshots: Playwright screenshot on every E2E test for AI UI/UX inspection

commitConvention.format: type(scope): description + N unit tests (TDD Phase X)
examples: test(validators): auth schema valid input tests + 15 tests (TDD Phase 2)
test(db): schema table definitions + 60 tests (TDD Phase 3)
test(auth): auth initialization config + 15 tests (TDD Phase 4)
test(api/extraction): text extraction regex + 31 tests (TDD Phase 5)
test(api/router): admin router stats + 16 tests (TDD Phase 6)
test(nextjs/auth): auth catch-all route + 8 tests (TDD Phase 8)
test(expo/auth): mobile auth token storage + 8 tests (TDD Phase 10)
test(integration): upload → OCR → extraction + 8 tests (TDD Phase 11)
test(e2e): patient upload flow with screenshots (TDD Phase 12)
chore(playwright): add Playwright config with screenshot capture (TDD Phase 12)
ci: add GitHub Actions workflow for test and build (TDD Phase 1)
ci: add coverage gate workflow with 80% threshold (TDD Phase 1)
